runSummary.stalePolicy: Only offers verified within the last 48 hours are eligible for LIVE display.
runSummary.note: Full diversity sweep on 8.9.2026 22:17 CEST. No new unique promotion-grade item passed ranking, locality and evidence gates. Profesia/company/LinkedIn and Slovak-board searches produced no stronger eligible delta than current LIVE/verification inventory. Worki surfaced Shield-Sk Administrátor e-shopu / zákaznícka podpora in Bratislava-Ružinov, but canonical detail explicitly says the vacancy is already filled/cancelled, so it was rejected inactive. Upwork returned several remote WordPress/admin candidates; the freshest strong-fit item is AI Blog Post VA for WordPress (Worldwide, entry level), but 120 articles/month for 30 USD fixed is far below a viable compensation floor. A 6-hour-old Content Management & Project Coordination role is remote worldwide but requires headless CMS experience plus good spoken/written English and Adobe/InDesign/Illustrator, creating a high skill/language burden. Reddit yielded no eligible fresh hiring lead and Facebook public index yielded 0 verified hiring posts. Existing 50 LIVE items are preserved fail-closed.

sources.note: Reálne vyhľadané fresh Worldwide remote WordPress/admin kandidáty. AI Blog Post VA for WordPress: 120 článkov/mesiac za 30 USD fixed = reject budget napriek entry-level a výbornému tematickému fitu.
